newsitem.title: KUWAIT: Kuwait Airways Corp raises fares 3.0 pct.
newsitem.headline: Kuwait Airways Corp raises fares 3.0 pct.

text.p: The state-owned Kuwait Airways Corp (KAC) has increased its fares to all destinations by three percent due to a rise jet fuel prices, the official Kuwait News Agency (KUNA) reported on Wednesday.
"KAC said today (Wednesday) it had adopted a three percent fare rise for all ticket grades to all sectors (regions) by as of December 15," said the agency.
The 251-member International Air Transport Association (IATA) in a November meeting proposed a global three percent rise in fares in response to a rise of about 40 percent in jet fuel prices.
"The increase is in line with the collective decision by an IATA meeting," said the agency. "KAC has taken this step after the approval of the concerned authorities."
